title: Halloween Night with DJ Jim
shortDescription: Halloween-night music with DJ Jim at Boze's Restaurant & Bar. Starts at 7:00 PM.
description: Join Four Dogs Entertainment for Halloween Night with DJ Jim at Boze's Restaurant & Bar in West Columbia on Saturday, October 31. Music starts at 7:00 PM Eastern.
instructions: Contact Boze's for seating and participation details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
